checks: Preserved immunity as protection mechanism with continuing infection risk even when healthy-looking. Diet/exercise/rest/sleep/mental state do not replace hand hygiene, clean/dirty distinction or standard precautions; no laughter/warmth/food infection-prevention guarantee, forced heating or burdensome activity.
Preserved rest versus staged sleep, fatigue/memory/emotion/health roles, approximately daily body clock/light/daytime-life cues, life history/health/habit and no age-imposed sleep/wake schedule.

Preserved recurrent NREM/REM, light-to-deep NREM stages and rapid eye movement/wake-like brain activity not actual wakefulness. Dreams or one illustration cannot establish stage; deep-sleep/awakening/age trends retain individual variation.

Preserved person-reported sleep facts, awakening time, noise/light and daytime impact, actual usual differences to responsible person, individualized rest/environment consultation and no independent medication/stage/disease diagnosis.

Preserved universal versus individually variable aging features and lifestyle/health/historical/environmental context. Capability not fixed by life-stage classification; bereavement/role loss and possible depressive state without assigning all elderly the same feeling or depression.

Preserved high-frequency hearing/visual-acuity/visual-field, muscle/fall, taste/chew/swallow, bowel/kidney/urination/respiratory/infection/circulatory perspectives and comparison against person’s baseline rather than universal age assumptions or taking over without wishes.

Preserved multiple/chronic diseases, complications and potentially atypical symptoms. No fever does not explain appetite reduction by age; team verifies treatment/medication/full information and dehydration/fever/constipation/edema/insomnia/function loss/pressure injury are not left untreated as normal aging.

Preserved fluid intake and losses through urine/sweat/diarrhea/vomiting/fever; actual dry-lip/mouth/skin and urine observations, pulse/pressure/temperature only as measured facts, no invented values/severity and no delay because person has not complained of thirst.

Preserved hot environment/exercise/bathing opportunities under plan; cardiac/renal fluid restriction and swallowing difficulty prohibit staff-only increased intake/method. Report dryness/low urine, request assessment and follow individual plan confirmed with healthcare professional; severe dehydration may need medical institution and urgent help per procedure.

Preserved hypothalamic temperature regulation, fever above personal usual state and possible infection/inflammation/dehydration without requiring all signs. Constipation includes stool texture/difficulty/incomplete sensation/frequency, baseline interval and discomfort.

Preserved24–72hour transit reference versus a diagnostic threshold; new pain/nausea/appetite loss reported without day-count-only conclusions. Fiber/activity/timing support is individual, with swallowing and fluid restrictions and no universal forced meal/time.

Preserved person-based right/left colon diagram as location guide, not abdominal pressing force/count instructions; no independent drugs/abdominal procedures. Persistent abdominal pain/vomiting/bloody stool with bowel difficulty goes promptly to healthcare professional without waiting days.

Preserved edema tissue fluid, possible cardiac/renal/nutrition/muscle/sitting contributors, weight not cause proof, affected side not automatic paralysis cause. Exercise/elevation only if personal state/plan appropriate; pain/new changes/unknown method to responsible person.

Preserved itching dryness/temperature/humidity/material/infection possibilities, redness/rash/location/severity/onset and observed scratching not clothing allergy diagnosis. Person’s words separate from actual skin, moisturizer product/plan and abnormalities with healthcare professional; no invented cause or new drugs/procedures.

Preserved sleep-onset difficulty/mid-sleep waking/unrefreshed sleep distinctions, recurrence/daytime effects and light/noise/pain/excretion context. Corridor-bell words/time not replaced by age cause; long naps discussed individually rather than blanket prohibition; daily-life impairment to healthcare-professional assessment and no staff-only hypnotic selection.
